name: multikill-definition-ablation-v1
hypothesis: Multi-kill round frequency or separate size buckets may describe impact better than kills beyond the first.

definitions.size_buckets: four separate fractions with exactly 2, exactly 3, exactly 4, or at least 5 kills

fixed: Other seven available families unchanged; objectives excluded because actor attribution is unavailable. Raw standardized ridge alpha=1, intercept unpenalized; eight-second existing trade definition. No operator normalization.
split: Use expanded-fit-plan.json seven pre-August events: 299 clean rows, leave-one-event-out, then full fit evaluated on 32 August EWC development rows. Both September events excluded, 60 NA final rows sealed.
comparison: Reuse recorded baseline models/metrics without refitting. Report pooled/event errors and raw-unit coefficient drift. No automatic winner or final-test evaluation.
status: Preregistered before running either variant. No tuning alpha or adding variants based on results.
